reason: The tray former and metal stock look like the first step in making the nursery, and it is the only offered action.
expectation: I expect a formed metal nursery tray, likely needing a liner and growing medium.

effect: The tray is formed as expected; it now needs its liner.
reaction: A straightforward, satisfying first construction step.
reason: The food-safe liner should make the tray suitable for the growing bed; it is the only combination offered.
expectation: I expect a lined nursery tray ready for the growing medium.

effect: The liner is in place, so the tray can now hold the medium.
reaction: As expected; the sequence is clear but prescribed.
reason: The granules provide a root bed, and this is the only offered combination.
expectation: I expect a filled nursery tray that can be watered and planted.

effect: The tray now contains the root medium; the wick is the next available part.
reaction: Predictable, with a clear physical purpose.
reason: The wick should supply the tray passively as the introduction suggested; this is the only combination offered.
expectation: I expect a wick-equipped tray, perhaps still needing connection to the reservoir.

effect: The wick is fitted and the tap is now available, matching the anticipated connection.
reaction: I like seeing the earlier survival equipment reused for the next crop.
reason: Connect the wicking tray to the nutrient reservoir so it can water the seedlings; it is the only combination offered.
expectation: I expect a passively watered nursery, ready for seeds.

effect: The nursery is watered and its construction goal is complete, leaving the next crop to start.
reaction: The completed setup is satisfying, though each step has had only one combination.
reason: Sow the lettuce in the prepared tray to start the crop; it is the only combination offered.
expectation: I expect a sown nursery and completion of the remaining goal.

effect: The seeds complete the nursery, and the visible rising moisture makes the passive wick's role concrete.
reaction: The dark line in the felt is a pleasing small image that ties the new crop to the storm.

mostWorthwhile.text: Sowing the tray and seeing moisture rise through the felt gave the construction a tangible payoff and connected it to the earlier storm.

leastWorthwhile.text: The successive forming, lining and filling steps were clear but repetitive; each offered only one combination.

surprise.text: The slow dark line rising through the felt made the passive watering visible; the wick's general purpose was already clear.

arbitrary.text: None felt purposeless: each part had a plausible role, though the single offered action at each step left little decision-making.

continue.text: I would continue for the larger story and the discovery in the ice, though this chapter on its own was too linear to draw me onward strongly.
